feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 November 2026 4:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 at 4:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic as a slow-moving frontal zone affects the north and east of the British Isles, will a deepening area of low pressure in the North Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly west or southwest 4 or 5 but east or northeast 3 to 5 in north to northeast parts of the area, becoming variable 2 to 4, occasionally 5 overnight. Becoming mainly southeast 3 to 5 but southwest 2 or 3 in the west and southwest of the area tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming slight overnight, then occasionally moderate in the south tomorrow.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers, particularly in the north.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly southeast 3 to 5 but southwest 2 or 3 in the west and southwest of the area, which will gradually back south or southeast Wednesday evening. Increasing 5 or 6 in northern parts of the area overnight into Thursday, then becoming east 5 or 6 in all waters Thursday morning, and occasionally 7 in the North Channel.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, becoming mainly moderate overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain gradually clearing to become mainly fair later on Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
